name: case5_acdc (Ergun et al. 2019; the 5-bus system of Stagg & El-Abiad with a three-terminal DC grid)
source: case5_acdc of PowerModelsACDC (the reference implementation of H. Ergun, J. Dave, D. Van Hertem, F. Geth, «Optimal Power Flow for AC/DC Grids: Formulation, Convex Relaxation, Linear Approximation and Implementation», IEEE Trans. Power Systems 34(4), 2019; the AC part from G. W. Stagg, A. H. El-Abiad, «Computer methods in power system analysis», 1968). The numbers of its file in the units of the engine, nothing changed: the DC buses at 2 × 345 kV pole to pole (a bipole), each DC line R = r·(345 kV)²/100 MVA a conductor and its rating 100 MW / 690 kV; every station with the transformer, filter and reactor of the file (pu of 100 MVA), the losses LossA (W), LossB (V), LossC (Ω), P within ±Pacmax, Q within Qacmin…Qacmax, I_max = √(Pacrated² + Qacrated²) pu as the reference implementation sets it, U_c within Vmmin…Vmmax; the controls of the stations for the AC/DC load flow from type_dc (1: P, 2: the DC slack) and P_g, Q_g.
